name: Validation funnel
question: Stable, unique, novel, and really a perovskite?
purpose: Independent evidence for every surviving candidate, and a full account of how many were rejected.
verdict_rule: the worst grade of its graded metrics
caveats: No DFT is run anywhere in this pipeline. Stability rests on two ML potentials agreeing, and is labelled as such.

metrics.name: Two potentials agree
metrics.definition: Share of candidates for which two independent ML potentials relax to the same space group.
metrics.meaning_good: The relaxed structure does not depend on which potential was used.
metrics.meaning_bad: The two potentials disagree, so the structure and its stability are not trustworthy.
metrics.remedy: Report the disagreement; do not claim stability.
metrics.reference_note: 70/70 on the discovery set (median lattice difference 0.024 A) and 16/16 on the MP set.

metrics.name: Known materials rediscovered
metrics.definition: Number of returned candidates that are experimentally known compounds, at their measured property.
metrics.meaning_good: The pipeline recovers real materials it was never shown, the most persuasive single check.
metrics.meaning_bad: No known material was recovered; say so rather than implying validation.
metrics.remedy: Relax the novelty filter for one run to see whether known compounds are reachable.

metrics.name: Stable share of the proposals
metrics.definition: Share of validated candidates within the hull-distance threshold.
metrics.remedy: Context: report the funnel, not a single number. Stability is the dominant filter.
metrics.reference_note: Funnel on the discovery set: 70 validated -> 68 absent from Materials Project -> 61 not in the literature -> 51 formable -> 17 stable -> 8 after the judges.

components.note: hull_mlip.py (energy above the hull, one potential for every phase; calibrated on known materials of the data)
needs: a reference set: the JARVIS-DFT dump or an MP key

components.note: d1_mlip_check.py (two potentials on generated cells: drop on relaxation, displacement, space group kept)
